wow.notes: Gauge story (1440-scroll-25.jpg), estimator that prints a session sheet in the hero's language, ear map now opening on a filled LOBE tape tag (1440-scroll-75.jpg): signature tied to the trade's real fear.

polish.notes: 1440-first.jpg 'CYCLE 0412 · PASS' and 1440-scroll-75.jpg tape labels are clean, no underscore artefacts. apple-touch, OG, JSON-LD, print and forced-colors present in dist.

elevate.move: Give photography a role in the log: 2-3 approved frames (sealed pouch or tray setup, the machine-in-caps frame, a healed piece) as taped evidence prints clipped into the cycle, hygiene and reviews entries, all in the same rose duotone, so the page reads setup → cycle → result and finally shows skin

Make the indicator tape visibly cycle: as each section enters, scrub its stripes from pre-cycle tan to cycled umber with the label ticking to PASS and the CHECKED stamp landing at the end, so the thesis becomes the scroll language instead of uniform fades (reduced motion: tapes drawn dark, no scrub)
